summary: Citizens Sunrise Transmission LLC files tariff revisions under section 205 on November 16, 2026, in ER27-499-000, answering the CAISO show cause order. It leases part of SDG&E's Sunrise Powerlink, so its revisions say SDG&E's tariff governs study, interconnection and expansion requests. The text matches the Citizens Sycamore-Penasquitos filing except for project facts.
ask: Accept the revisions effective January 15, 2027, and find that Citizens Sunrise has satisfied the concerns in the show cause order.

points.point: Citizens Sunrise owns none of the line. SDG&E keeps ownership, operation and maintenance.
points.quote: Citizens Sunrise does not own any of the actual facilities. SDG&E retains ownership and operation and maintenance responsibilities.

points.point: It is a non-load-serving transmission owner with no end-use customers.
points.quote: Non-Load-Serving Participating TO and has no End-Use Customers

points.point: Its current tariff already hands the interconnection and expansion sections to SDG&E's tariff while the lease with SDG&E is in effect.
points.quote: superseded by the corresponding sections of the TO Tariff of San Diego Gas & Electric

points.point: Study, planning, interconnection and expansion requests would be governed by SDG&E's tariff.
points.quote: any study, planning, interconnection or expansion requests related to Citizens Sunrise’s interest in the Sunrise Project will be governed by the relevant provisions of the SDG&E TO Tariff

points.point: New language in Sections 8, 9 and 10 repeats the point, one section at a time.
points.quote: Added new language to Section 10, Interconnection Process, to confirm that all conduct that falls under Section 10 will be governed by SDG&E’s TO Tariff

points.point: Definitions are revised to say SDG&E's tariff provisions govern.
points.quote: each to clarify that SDG&E’s TO Tariff provisions will govern

points.point: It commits to a compliance filing if CAISO or SDG&E changes its tariff in a way that affects these revisions.
points.quote: Citizens Sunrise commits to making a compliance filing to ensure its TO Tariff remains consistent

points.point: It asks for an effective date 60 days after filing.
points.quote: accept these TO Tariff revisions to become effective January 15, 2027, which is sixty (60) days from the date of this filing

throughLine.text: Filed under section 205 to answer the E-10 show cause order for CAISO and its transmission owners. It sends large load study and interconnection matters to SDG&E's tariff rather than setting up a process of its own.
